result.title: RSKD: Grounding Semantic Consistency in Driving VLMs via Distillation
result.summary: Knowledge distillation can transfer large multimodal models to compact models for autonomous driving, but uniform token-level matching can dilute planning-relevant semantics and amplify teacher errors. We propose RSKD, a semantic-consistency-guided distillation framework that routes supervision according to both the task importance of an answer phrase and its semantic consistency with the teacher prediction. Task-critical semantic phrases are localized in the ground-truth answer, and a phrase-level consistency score controls the balance between Jensen--Shannon divergence (JSD) distillation and ground-truth supervision. Teacher information is emphasized only where it is semantically consistent, while semantically inconsistent phrases receive stronger ground-truth supervision. We evaluate RSKD on DrivingVQA, LingoQA, and MapLMv2. RSKD improves over the compared student-based baselines on DrivingVQA and LingoQA and remains competitive on MapLMv2.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RSKD 蒸馏框架，按答案短语的任务重要性及其与教师预测的语义一致性分配监督，在 JSD 蒸馏与真值监督间动态平衡，并在多个驾驶 VQA 基准上评估。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按语义单元筛选并重加权教师监督的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的短语级监督与教师错误抑制提供核查线索，但论文本身不研究推理期状态生成。
